UE 5.6 alpha.6 — Forge plugin directory

Alpha.6 installs the engine plugin at <EngineRoot>/Engine/Plugins/Marketplace/Forge. The package and project-local plugin folder use the same Forge directory name. The descriptor filename MajesticForge.uplugin, editor/runtime module IDs, DLL names, Blueprint class paths and the %LOCALAPPDATA%/MajesticForge/sessions registration path stay unchanged; they continue to identify existing Unreal projects and assets.

The engine installer treats Marketplace/MajesticForge as the previous install location. With -Update, it moves the old directory into the normal rollback backup and installs the new package in Marketplace/Forge. If both folders exist, it stops and asks for manual inspection rather than guessing which copy is active.

Validation

  • Installer and safe-extraction tests: passed, including migration backup from the old engine directory name.
  • UE 5.6.1 isolated editor target: 29 actions passed with the plugin under Plugins/Forge and the legacy descriptor/module identifiers retained.
  • Package Artifacts/ForgeMCP-Unreal-Alpha-0.2.13-alpha.6-UE5.6.1-Win64.zip; SHA-256 2b21295fc6c1fdd37810f03b2bca7db3d7f0d7f788f32e4c86acdf052b14fe95.
  • Disposable editor loaded the packaged DLL from Plugins/Forge/Binaries/Win64/UnrealEditor-MajesticForge.dll; the authenticated MCP subprocess discovered the editor and verified its live project identity.

The engine-wide folder move is staged but has not been installed because the user's UE 5.6 editor still has the previous plugin DLL loaded. The installer blocks the move while an editor from this engine is running. After that editor closes, install with -Update, then verify the loaded DLL under Marketplace/Forge.
